name: Sero Positive Illness Scheme
benefit: Level of Study Day Scholars HostellersStd. 1 to 5 ₹500 (₹50/month for uniform) + ₹1,500 annually-Std. 6 to 10₹1,000/- (₹100/month for uniform) + ₹1,500 annually -Class 11-12 ₹4,000/- (₹400/month for fees and books for ten months)₹10,000/- (Rs. 400/- per month for fees and books for ten months and ₹600/- per month for food and hostel charges)B.A./B.Com./B.Sc and equivalent degree courses ₹6,0
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a child affected by Sero Positive illness or should have one or both parents who are Sero Positive. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be studying in any following standard: - Standard 1 to 5. - Standard 6 to 10. - Higher Secondary Class-11 and 12. - B.A./B.Com./B.AC. and equivalent degree courses. - Degree courses like B.E., B.Tech., LLB., MBA and equivalent courses as well as Diploma courses in Medical and Ayurvedic and Homeopathic courses. - Postgraduate level courses like M.Sc./ M.Phil./ LLM./ M.Ed./ M.B.A. etc.
